name: CASTECH Inc.
blurb: CASTECH Inc. (SZSE: 002222), founded in Fuzhou, Fujian in 1990 and listed in Shenzhen in 2008, is the world's largest mass-production supplier of several nonlinear optical crystals, including LBO (lithium triborate), BBO (beta-barium borate), KTP (potassium titanyl phosphate), and Nd:YVO4 (neodymium-doped yttrium orthovanadate). These materials are the seed elements inside virtually every industrial solid-state laser, frequency-doubling system, and scientific Q-switched laser in the world — a defensible position built over three decades of process know-how. The company also produces precision optical components and laser devices used in semiconductor equipment, AR/VR, radar, LiDAR, optical communications, biomedicine, and quantum information research. CASTECH appeared in Coherent Corp.'s 2022 10-K under Photonic Solutions competitors.
recent: CASTECH reported 2024 revenue of 875.72 million CNY (up 12% year-over-year) with net profit of 218.79 million CNY (up 4.7%). The current share price is approximately 92 CNY with a market capitalisation near 33 billion CNY. The company participated in Laser World of Photonics China 2026 and OPIE 2026, showcasing expansions in semiconductor-equipment and AR-related optical components — sectors that provide incremental growth atop its core laser crystal business.
